prompt_summary: Build a local-first Roblox studio that a beginner can host on their own hardware and that must surpass the public Ropilot capabilities, not merely match them.

unslop_direction.product: A local desktop studio where a Roblox developer connects their own model and reviews every file change before it lands.
unslop_direction.world: A graphite night workbench with one acid-lime instrument lamp.
unslop_direction.moments: The welcome question, and the approval diff where a write or command is accepted.
unslop_direction.signature: A 6px lime status dot for the live model connection.

explicit_requirements: Anyone can host Open-Ro locally and reach a working game by prompting, including beginners and low-end hardware
Preset skills, preset connections, and a downloadable model and asset library
Live published-game upkeep that cites real official metrics and never publishes without approval
For every public Ropilot capability, Open-Ro is not done until it is measurably past that capability
Approval before file writes, shell commands, and any change to a live experience
implicit_domain_standards: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and keyboard access for the desktop shell
Project tools cannot escape the selected folder

waves.name: Trust boundary and approval queue
waves.verification_oracle: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build

waves.name: Beginner first run that does not pretend a game exists
Studio evidence loop past a reviewable diff
waves.verification_oracle: A recorded Studio session with assertions and screenshots

waves.name: Live experience upkeep from official metrics
waves.verification_oracle: A recommendation that quotes a fetched metric, and a test that empty data produces no recommendation

definition_of_done: Each surpass_checklist item is VERIFIED against its surpass_bar, not against a match
A beginner on a stated hardware tier can prompt a playable loop and the run stores playtest evidence
A live-experience recommendation quotes a real metric, source, and time range, and a publish is a separate approval
README describes only behavior with command or session evidence
competitor_sources_not_fully_read: https://analytics.ropilot.ai/ timed out on direct fetch; a search index of that URL showed a public board of other games' CCU, growth, and session length
https://app.ropilot.ai/ was not fully fetched; a search index described bring-your-own provider, a Studio plugin install, optional Rojo sync, and user-authored skill notes

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux that installs a Studio plugin
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: Install, update, and uninstall are recorded on a low-end and a high-end machine. No Open-Ro account is required. A local model path works with the network off.
surpass_checklist.evidence: Electron shell and Windows/Linux packaging config exist. No installer was run. macOS is not a documented target.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Reads an existing place's game tree and scripts
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: A read returns a saved tree snapshot. A missing service is reported as missing and is not invented.
surpass_checklist.evidence: No Studio plugin and no DataModel reader. The MCP form can launch a stdio server the user types.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Writes Luau and UI into the correct service
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: The diff names the instance path, a read-back confirms that path, and server-owned currency or rewards are typed and checked.
surpass_checklist.evidence: Local file writes can be staged. Nothing places instances into a Studio service.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Playtests in Studio by clicking, checking state, and capturing screenshots, then fixes and reruns
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: A pass stores the assertions, screenshots, and state checks. A failure stores the failing check. A result with no evidence cannot be marked passed.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Shows a diff before a change is applied and the user decides what ships
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: The review shows a line diff and can restore the previous file. Rejecting leaves the file unchanged. Studio edits get the same gate.
surpass_checklist.evidence: Local writes use an approval id and checkpoints. tests/safety.test.ts covers approval expiry and path escape. Electron was not launched. Studio edits do not exist.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Drives Blender for models and keyframe animation and shows a 3D preview in chat
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: Mesh and animation files are reviewed before import. Import is its own approval. The preview opens the produced file.
surpass_checklist.evidence: capabilities.ts can run blender --version. There is no Blender task runner.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Uses managed credits or an optional Claude or ChatGPT plan
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: No Open-Ro credit wallet. A local model answers with no cloud key. A paid provider is optional and the request shows where the data goes.
surpass_checklist.evidence: The catalog lists Ollama and llama.cpp first, both keyless and loopback. Paid APIs remain optional. No live inference was run. Open-Ro does not sell credits and has no telemetry client. The indexed app.ropilot.ai text said inference is not included, which conflicts with the marketing pages above.

surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: The provider is optional, the image stays local until the user approves an upload, and the license is shown.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Optional Rojo file sync for people who already use it
surpass_checklist.source: Indexed https://app.ropilot.ai/ text, not a full page fetch
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: Sync direction and overwrite scope are shown and approved before files move.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Beginner can describe a feature without writing Luau
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: A first-run on a named hardware tier produces a playable loop and attaches the playtest evidence. The UI does not use specialist jargon for that path.
surpass_checklist.evidence: Chat, provider forms, and a project picker exist. They do not produce a game.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Preset skills and a downloadable model or asset library
surpass_checklist.source: Not offered as a downloadable library on the pages read. Indexed app text describes user-authored skill notes.
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: Skills are local files the user can open. A test proves the skill text sent to the model. Asset downloads show a checksum and a license and are optional.
surpass_checklist.evidence: No skill pack and no asset catalog.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Hardware requirement is a PC with Roblox Studio
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: Low, mid, and high tiers are documented and tested. Low tier can use a remote model. High tier can run fully local.

surpass_checklist.public_capability: Live upkeep of the user's published experience from official stats, with approved patches
surpass_checklist.source: Not described on the pages read. https://analytics.ropilot.ai/ timed out; its search index shows other games' public CCU, growth, and session length, which is not this capability.
surpass_checklist.surpass_bar: A recommendation quotes the metric, the official source, and the time range. No data means no recommendation. Publishing is a separate approval from editing. Keys stay in OS secure storage.
surpass_checklist.evidence: No Open Cloud client and no analytics store.
